% titletoc's run-in entries, \titlecontents*, at the top level of an
% article without hyperref: a run-in section whose format adds space above
% the entry and sets no bold, so the measured space and weight differ from
% article's.

\usepackage{titletoc}
\titlecontents*{section}[0pt]{\addvspace{1pc}}{\thecontentslabel\ }{}{}
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents

Text of iota.

Text of iota one.
\section{Kappa}
Text of kappa.
\end{document}
